gamutClip.light --nominal-2-soft-foreground: oklch(0.47 0.09 180) lies outside sRGB (red channel -0.065 after the transfer curve, measured 2026-10-06); the plan's claim that every value is in gamut was wrong for this one. It is clipped per channel to sRGB, which is how browsers paint an out-of-gamut oklch() in the app today, so the Brain Chat mark keeps the app tab's ink. Any OTHER out-of-gamut value still fails the generator, and an entry here whose value is back in gamut fails it too (STALE_CLIP).
